verdict.rationale: Recurly RevRec is documented as automating revenue recognition for ASC 606 and IFRS 15, including contract modifications and multi-currency support. Recurly's export documentation also lists revenue recognition reports alongside invoices and transactions drawn from billing data, which covers the core of the story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of deferred revenue schedules, evidence that recognition reports are audit-ready (the only compliance mention is a generic note about keeping records), clarity on whether RevRec is a separate add-on, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
